slice_contract.real_problem: The position-1 M23B control acquired five complete fixed-Pro/high arms, then the sixth arm durably closed its production terminal, Store reopen and external verifier before one response ended with usage_incomplete=true and billing_unknown=false. The six canonical behaviors must be classified independently without admitting cost truth, completing the 60-arm baseline or rerunning any mate.
acceptance: validate the exact ignored 0600 regular non-symlink 41-record hash-chained journal with no partial tail
derive exactly six canonical Store trajectories, five complete arm labels and one accounting_incomplete abort
retain the five complete arms as behavior and accounting observations without exposing raw model or tool content
classify the sixth trajectory from canonical terminal, latest receipt, workspace, lane and verifier facts even though it has no arm_result
classify the sixth accounting axis as usage_incomplete and exclude it from cost, token and full-utility aggregate
keep the 54 unexecuted schedule arms outside product and loss labels
require the same stable owner/cause across at least two independent task IDs before returning a candidate audit
produce byte-identical canonical JSON across repeated runs without credential read or network access
slice_contract.owner: the existing trajectory-report mode in scripts/eval-m9b-fixed-pro-regression.py
slice_contract.old_path_replaced: manual raw inspection or collapsing an accounting stop into either a successful complete baseline or a product failure
slice_contract.cutover: retain immutable raw identity and one read-only report; do not continue the campaign, run high/max or implement a production treatment

derivation.canonical_source: canonical_store_snapshot payload facts, matching credential-free sqlite_reopen_snapshot, external verifier snapshot and canonical Runtime events
derivation.label_source: behavior truth is independent of arm_result; accounting truth is projected independently from canonical ModelAccounting
derivation.acquisition_stop: arm index 5 closed terminal, Store reopen and verifier, then accounting_projection rejected complete=false, usage_complete=false, usage_incomplete=true, billing_unknown=false and maximum_reruns=0
product_loss: verifier-passing workspace without a latest Host receipt
production terminal failure with closed identity and environment
non_loss: usage_incomplete accounting when behavior truth is independently closed
initial verifier failure required by the frozen task
derivation.candidate_threshold: one identical stable owner_code:loss_code across at least two distinct task IDs
derivation.owner_attribution_gate: an accounting stop never authorizes a production owner audit by itself

exclude: accounting status as a behavior label
raw tool count without causal loss
